name: Geometer
deck: Extra-terrestrial enemy of Quasar

name: George Pérez
deck: An artist who has appeared in comics on numerous occations

name: George W. Bush
deck: George Bush was the 43rd President of the United States of America. His father George W. H. Bush was the 41st President. He has owned companies, sporting, and his own ranch in Texas. He was in the Air Force National Guard.

name: Germān Aguilar
deck: Germān is a young animage and a student enrolled at Strange Academy.

name: Ghost
deck: Ghost is an industrial saboteur and mercenary who possesses an incredible stealth suit that grants him invisibility and intangibility, among other capabilities.

name: Ghost Rider (Blaze)
deck: Johnny Blaze, a motorcycle stuntman, became bound to the Spirit of Vengeance known as Zarathos after making a deal with Mephisto to spare the life of his surrogate father. With the power to control hellfire and to inflict pain on those he deems evil with his Penance Stare, Johnny seeks vengeance as Ghost Rider.

name: Ghost Rider (Reyes)
deck: A talented young mechanic with a penchant for anything with an engine and electronic music, but above all else he loves his little brother Gabe. When his plan to get Gabe out of East L.A. goes fatally awry, he is resurrected by the Spirit of Eli Morrow into the supernatural being, the All-New Ghost Rider!

name: Ghost Rider 1,000,000 BC
deck: First Spirit of Vengeance. Member of the Avengers 1,000,000 BC.

name: Gideon Wilson
deck: Sam Wilson's brother who was previously involved with Gamma Corps.

name: Giganto
deck: Giganto is a behemoth whale creature summoned by the Horn of Proteus. Namor would call upon Giganto to attack the surface world and the Fantastic Four.

name: Gila
deck: Gila is a humanoid gila monster created by Dominus.

name: Gilgamesh
deck: His true name lost in the mists of time, The Forgotten One is a member of the immortal race called the Eternals. He has been known by many names but he is once more who he must ever be: The Forgotten One.

name: Gladiator
deck: Kallark, codenamed Gladiator, was once the Praetor of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard, the most faithful servant of the Shi'ar throne. After the Shi'ar-Kree War, with the apparent death of Lilandra and Vulcan, Kallark is elevated to the position of Majestor by consensus of a desperate Shi'ar populace.

name: Gladiator (Potter)
deck: One of Daredevil's first enemies who eventually reformed and became one of his supporters.

name: Gladiatrix
deck: A former wrestler, Gladiatrix turned over a new leaf and attempted to join the Avengers. During Civil War, she worked with the Secret Avengers.

name: Glenn Talbot
deck: Glenn Talbot was a major in the U.S. Air Force who hunted the Hulk with Gen. Ross. He later married Betty Ross, but they divorced. He later became a Colonel. He recently resurfaced in the Fall of the Hulks storyline.

name: Glob
deck: A number of individuals have appeared as the Glob. The First Glob is a mute, undead and unliving being.

name: Glob Herman
deck: Glob was a student at Xavier's mansion and a member of the Omega Gang under the leadership of Quentin Quire. He since attended the Jean Grey School, lived on Krakoa as a vegetable farmer, and is currently the X-Men's resident cook.

name: Glomm
deck: In the period when Kang declared war on Earth, Glomm who was a being produced by the Deviants, rebelled against the empire and became a soldier serving under Dulpus.

name: Glory Grant
deck: Secretary to J. Jonah Jameson.

name: Goldbug
deck: Goldbug is a minor villain, who was obsessed with gold. He has faced off against many heroes.

name: Golden Archer
deck: Wyatt McDonald is the finest archer of Earth-712, home to the Squadron Supreme. However, despite his brilliant skills, he has been removed from the Squadron for brainwashing his former girlfriend, Lady Lark.

name: Golden Girl
deck: Golden Girl was a Golden Age heroine who once served as Captain America's sidekick.

name: Gorgon
deck: As a result of being exposed to the Terrigen Mist when he was an infant, Gorgon developed hooved feet and a powerful lower body. His legs are so powerful that with a single stomp, he can create shock tremors to disable his opponents.

name: Gorilla-Man
deck: A mercenary who was cursed to be stuck in the body of an immortal gorilla. He is one of Marvel's oldest characters and member of the Agents of Atlas, named for the former name of Marvel Comics.

name: Gorr
deck: Gorr is a Kronan who fought Thor.

name: Gorr
deck: Gorr the God Butcher is by far one of Thor's deadliest villains, whose sole purpose in life is to destroy all Gods/Elder-Gods across the Multiverse, believing them to be inherently cruel, capricious, and illegitimate. Armed with the mysterious Necroblade--a weapon that commands ancient, ebon energies--and an unyielding resentment for all things divine, Gorr was pushed to create the Godbomb which would have made them obsolete.

name: Grand Director
deck: Steven Rogers [formely William Burnside] was the fourth Captain America and was active in the 1950s. He has resurfaced since often fronting extremist causes and appearing as an antagonist to the real Captain America.

name: Grandmaster
deck: An incredibly ancient being, the Grandmaster possesses a high level of cosmic power.

name: Graviton
deck: Graviton was a physicist, named Franklin Hall, who was involved in an experiment in a private research facility in the Canadian Rockies. A mistake in Hall's calculations causes graviton particles to merge with his own molecules, and Hall later discovers that he can mentally control gravity.

name: Graymalkin
deck: Graymalkin is a mutant who gets stronger in darkness. He is currently enrolled at the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning.

name: Great Beast of Pol
deck: The Great Beast of Pol was a giant monster on Ahl-Agullo that was slayed by Augullux the Brave.

name: Green Lama
deck: Green Lama's first appearance was in December 1940, during the Golden Age of Comics. He is now a key figure in Dynamite Entertainment's comic "Project SuperPowers". He is also a new member of Masks, Dynamite Entertainments new vigilante team. The character is owned by the Crossen Estate.

name: Green Skull
deck: A maniac hippie that believes the only way to save the earth is to kill off mankind.

name: Greithoth
deck: The Breaker of Wills is one of the seven spirits who served Cul. Member of the Worthy.

name: Grey Gargoyle
deck: The Grey Gargoyle can turn his body into stone and others into stone for a period of one hour.

name: Grid
deck: Dinesh Deol is a new Inhuman who was saved by Medusa and her people from Hydra agents. He can see and manipulate electromagnetic fields.

name: Griffin (Franklin)
deck: A former member of the Circus of Crime, Griffin is a gamma-irradiated member of the Gamma Corps.

name: Grim Reaper
deck: Eric Williams is the brother of Wonder Man who was killed and brought back to life using black magic. As the Grim Reaper, Eric has fought The Avengers numerous times and harbors a hatred for the Vision - whose brainwaves were copied from Eric's brother - and Wonder Man himself, believing he is an imposter of the real Simon Williams.

name: Groot
deck: Groot is an extraterrestrial, sentient tree-like creature, and the monarch of Planet X. He is a founding member of Star-Lord's Guardians of the Galaxy, and is known for his longtime friendship with Rocket Raccoon.

name: Grott
deck: Member of the Minions of Menace

name: Gruning
deck: German member of the villainous Exiles who prefers to fight with a whip.

name: Guero Valdez
deck: A local street thug who harasses Robbie Reyes and his little brother Gabe. Guero later becomes a member of Mr. Hydes gang the "Blue Hyde Brigade".

name: Gullin
deck: The Boar-God

name: Gundar
deck: Gundar was a Viking captain who gained a reputation for cruelty against his own crew members.

name: Gunthar the Rigellian
deck: Gunthar the Rigellian was a member of a space pirate crew, serving under Nebula. He could mentally control others, fire psionic blasts and increase his density to gain armor-like skin. He was cruel and mirthless, tormenting those lower than him in hierarchy.

name: Guslaug
deck: Guslaug is a Frost Giant enrolled at Strange Academy.

name: Gwen Stacy
deck: Gwen Stacy was the first true love of Peter Parker. She's best known for her tragic death by being thrown off from the Brooklyn Bridge by the Green Goblin. The Earth-65 version is Spider-Gwen who is a major player in the Spider family.

name: H. Warren Craddock
deck: The last of the four Skrulls from the initial encounter with the Fantastic Four.

name: Hal Chandler
deck: Brother of Chuck Chandler and was for a time merged with him to become the original 3-D Man.

name: Hammerhead
deck: A small time criminal that worked his way up to having his own crime family within the Maggia.

name: Hank Pym
deck: Hank Pym is a scientific genius, a founding member of the Avengers, the creator of Pym Particles and of Ultron, and a modern-day superhero who suffers from a Bipolar disorder. He has acted under many memorable identities such as Ant-Man, Giant Man, Goliath, Yellowjacket, and the Wasp. He is also the Earth's Scientist Supreme, as decreed by Eternity.

name: Happy Hogan
deck: Hired by Tony Stark as his chauffeur and personal assistant after Happy saves Tony's life.

name: Hassle
deck: Member of the Midnight Wreckers and ally to Machine Man.

name: Havok
deck: Havok is the son of Corsair and brother of Cyclops, and Vulcan, and has led both the Brotherhood of Mutants, and X-Factor. He also was part of Uncanny Avengers and Starjammers.

name: Hawkeye
deck: Trained by criminals and inspired by heroes, Clint Barton has grown from a troubled youth into one of the greatest heroes on Earth. The world knows him best as Hawkeye: Earth's Mightiest Marksman. A member of the Avengers for many years, he has left the team on occasion because of team friction. But he always returns, ready to face any threat.

name: Haywire
deck: A former member of the Redeemers and Squadron Supreme, Haywire has the ability to make limitless steel-like wire come from his fingers and can entangle people in them.

name: He Who Remains
deck: Monitor of the Timelines

name: Heap
deck: Baron Eric von Emmelmann, a World War I German flying ace who was shot down in 1918 over a Polish swamp. Through the decades his body decayed and intermingled with the vegetation around him, becoming one with the marshland itself until at last it arose from the muck during the early years of World War II as The Heap.

name: Heather McNeil Hudson
deck: Heather McNeil took over the leadership of Alpha Flight following the death of her husband Guardian, through the use of his Battle Suit. After her husband was revived and resumed the role of Guardian, Heather became the Vindicator and continued to be a member of Alpha Flight.

name: Hedy Wolfe
deck: Patsy Walker's best friend and closest frenemy.

name: Heimdall
deck: The Norse God of Vigilance, Protection and Light, and the guardian of the rainbow bridge Bifrost which links Asgard to the rest of the Nine Worlds.

name: Heinz Kruger
deck: One of Captain America's first enemies and the killer of Professor Erskine. His action let to Steve Rogers becoming the first and only Super-Soldier.

name: Hela
deck: Hela is the Norse Goddess of Death and ruler of Hel and Niffleheim.

name: Helen Cobb
deck: A famous pilot that inspired Carol Danvers. When she died of old age, she gave Carol her airplane.

name: Hellcat
deck: Patsy Walker had long idolized super heroes and after given the chance of a lifetime became 'Hellcat'. She is one of Marvel's oldest characters, dating back to her 'romantic' comic books in the 1940s. She has served on several incarnations of the Defenders and the Avengers.

name: Hellfire
deck: Codenamed Hellfire, J.T. James has the power to generate hellfire due to being descended from the original Phantom Rider. He was discovered and trained by Nick Fury to be one of Fury's Secret Warriors.

name: Hellhorse
deck: Once the horse of Black Knight, Elendil became Dreadknight's Hellhorse.

name: Hellion
deck: Julian Keller a.k.a. Hellion is a powerful telekinetic mutant. He was a student at the Xavier Institute, leader of the Hellions squad and Emma Frost's prize pupil. After joining the New X-Men Hellion fought many time for mutantkind, but lost his hands during the battle for San Francisco in Second Coming. Julian is currently a pro-mutant extremist, going by the mantle The Krakoan.

name: Hellstorm
deck: Denying his infernal heritage, the Son of Satan uses his abilities for the betterment of mankind, but has at times succumbed to his darker, demonic side, even clashing brutally with the forces of both Heaven and Hell.

name: Henry Gyrich
deck: Henry Peter Gyrich, an ambitious politician, has often been a thorn in the side to the superhuman community. Afraid of that which is different, Gyrich has often hindered the effectiveness of superheroes and has been among the first to blame them for society's ills.

name: Henry Pym Jr
deck: Henry Pym Jr. is the son of Hank Pym and the Wasp in the alternate reality MC2. Another version of Henry Pym Jr. surfaced in the pages of the Avengers, where he was part of the Kid Avengers.

name: Hepzibah
deck: Hepzibah is a Mephitisoid with a long standing hatred of the Shi'ar. She is the weapons officer of the Starjammers & love of Christopher Summers (aka Corsair). Following Corsair's death, she began a romantic relationship with Warpath (James Proudstar).

name: Hera
deck: The Queen of Olympus and wife to Zeus. She is the Goddess of Marriage and Monogamy. Her Roman counterpart is Juno.

name: Hercules
deck: One of six Olympian sons of Zeus, Hercules was born the savior of the Gods and mankind. Known as the Prince of Power, Hercules is one of the strongest beings in existence, an Olympian God and a modern superhero recognized throughout the world for his might. He has been a champion of mankind since ancient times and continues to defend the world in the modern age - most frequently as a member of the Avengers.

name: Hermod
deck: He is the Asgardian God of Speed and messenger of Odin.

name: High Evolutionary
deck: Herbert Wyndham is a geneticist from the 1930s who became obsessed with further evolution experiments which he used on himself. Depending on what he hopes to gain from whatever his current experiments are, he has been a force for the greater good, and for his own dark purposes.

name: Hiram Dobbs
deck: A crotchety old man living on a sun-crested South Atlantic island, Mr. Dobbs is ornerier than a rattlesnake on a hotplate. He courageously took a stand against Roxxon and defended his homesteading.

name: Hiroim
deck: Hiroim was a failed Shadow Priest turned Shadow Warrior turned slave then revolutionary alongside the Hulk on the planet Sakaar. He met his end on Earth after first coming to get revenge on the humans for the Hulk, yet he died saving human lives.

name: Hobgoblin (Kingsley)
deck: Roderick Kingsley became a worthy heir of the Goblin legacy, creating his own identity, of the Hobgoblin, rather than being just another Green Goblin clone.

name: Hogun
deck: Part of the Warriors Three along with Volstagg and Fandral, and good friend to Thor, Hogun is a short-tempered Asgardian. He is a skilled battlefield warrior, a great horseman, and a master of weapons. He prefers the use of a mace when battling his enemies.

name: Hope Summers
deck: The first mutant born after M-Day, Hope Summers is believed to either be the mutant messiah or the harbinger of death for humanity. She is an Omega-level mutant and possesses an innate connection to the Phoenix Force. During the First Krakoan Age Hope led the mutant circuit known as The Five, whom were responsible for the gift of mutant resurrection.

name: Hornet
deck: Peter Parker was the first Hornet using a jetpack given to him by Hobie Brown A.K.A. Prowler. Later a science prodigy and handicapped with a palsied arm, Eddie McDonough adventured as the Slinger called Hornet and was killed by a brainwashed Wolverine.

name: Horus
deck: Egyptian God of Sky and Justice. . In the parody limited series 1963 by Alan Moore, Horus is the homage to early Marvel Thor.

name: Howard the Duck
deck: Howard is a cigar-smoking anthropomorphic duck who lived in New Stork City on the planet Duckworld (in a parallel dimension). He was transported to and became trapped on our world, where he became close friends with Beverly Switzler. Most people of Earth simply do not believe that he is a talking duck.

name: Hugh Jones
deck: The former President and CEO of Roxxon, the corrupt Hugh Jones became an Avengers enemy after donning the Serpent Crown and becoming a faithful servant to Set.

name: Hugin
deck: Hugin (Thought) is one of Odin's Ravens.

name: Hulk
deck: After being bombarded with a massive dose of gamma radiation while saving a young man's life during an experimental bomb testing, Dr. Robert Bruce Banner was transformed into the Incredible Hulk: a green behemoth who is the living personification of rage and pure physical strength.

name: Hulkling
deck: Teddy is a half-Kree, half-Skrull alien raised as a human. He took the name Hulkling when he joined the Young Avengers and commands the newly formed Kree/Skrull Alliance.

name: Human Torch
deck: The second most powerful member of the Fantastic Four and the younger brother of Sue Richards. Due to an accident caused by cosmic radiation in space, he can manipulate fire, turn his entire body into it and fly. While Johnny is known for his impetuous and sometimes reckless nature, he is also a loyal friend and fearless hero.

name: Hunter's Moon
deck: A second Fist of Khonshu chosen during Khonshu's imprisonment by Asgardians. He originally rivaled Marc Specter, the current Moon Knight, before becoming a trustworthy member of Marc's Midnight Mission.

name: Husk
deck: Husk is a mutant with the ability to husk her skin to expose a new type and layer of skin underneath. Originally a member of Generation X, Paige graduated into the X-Men.

name: Hussar
deck: Hussar is a member of the Imperial Guard and her duty is to protect and defend the ruler and the Shi'ar galactic empire. She defends herself with a whip that can channel a bioelectric shock.

name: Hydro-Man
deck: Spider-Man villain with Hydrokinesis (the ability to control water), often part of teams with vendettas against the wall-crawler. Embodies the literal opposite of Spidey's other foe, Sandman.

name: Hyperion
deck: Hyperion is Marvel's first Superman pastiche. He is most often associated with the super-team known as the Squadron Supreme and was an Avenger at one point. Though he is one of many active versions across a myriad of alternate universes, Hyperion is still one of the mightiest super-humans in the Marvel Multiverse.

name: Iceman
deck: The youngest member of the original X-Men. Bobby is an Omega-level mutant, although it took some help from Emma Frost to realize this. Bobby's control of ice is vast; he can create shields, clones, spikes, slides and also freeze others. He was recently elected to Krakoa's X-Men

name: Idol Alabaster
deck: The most eager member of the Ashen Combine who craves worshipers.

name: Igor Drenkov
deck: A Soviet spy sent to America to learn the secrets of Bruce Banner's Gamma Bomb.

name: Ikaris
deck: He is a member of the Third Generation of Eternals. He is one of the men respected among the most righteous of the Eternals. His real name has never been revealed; the name he currently uses is in honor of his late son Nephilite, who inspired the legend of the same name.

name: Ikon
deck: Ikon is an enigmatic female Spaceknight who appeared on Knowhere claiming to be the leader of The Annihilators and the Greatest Living Spaceknight.

name: Ikonn
deck: Ikonn, otherwise known as the Lord of Illusions, was one of the Octessence, and is capable of producing truly believable illusions, a power that he transferred to the Ivory Idol of Ikonn.

name: Impossible Man
deck: A mischievous shape-shifter from the planet Poppup, Impossible Man has complete control over his molecular structure and reality-warping abilities.

name: Imus Champion
deck: A wealthy entrepreneur and enemy of the Avengers and Squadron Supreme.

name: In-Betweener
deck: The In-Betweener is a servant of the forces of Order and Chaos. He makes sure there is always a balance between the two worlds and draws his powers from both as well.

name: Inferno
deck: Inferno is the avatar of Balthakk

name: Inferno
deck: Dante was a resident of Des Plaines, Illinois until the Terrigen Mists appeared and turned him into the Inhuman, Inferno.

name: Insidio
deck: Insidio was the torturer of the Starblasters

name: Intruder
deck: Intruder is a caveman-like alien.

name: Invisible Woman
deck: Susan Storm is a founding member of the Fantastic Four and later the Future Foundation. She is able to create invisible force fields of any shape she conceives and able to turn herself and anything she's in contact with invisible. Sue is the wife of Reed Richards and the mother of their children, Franklin and Valeria.

name: Irelle
deck: A young Inhuman girl. She is the daughter of Auran, she has a twin sister named Treste.

name: Iron Boy
deck: During The Crossing, Iron Man went mad and became violent following the manipulation of Immortus. Hoping to save him, the Avengers travelled to an alternate reality and recruited a younger Tony Stark. As Iron Boy, he fought alongside the Avengers until his death at the hands of Onslaught.

name: Iron Fist
deck: Before his death, Danny Rand was the most well-known immortal Iron Fist: protector of the mystical city of K'un Lun. Now, he is a Spirit of Vengeance for an Egyptian god. He is among the best fighters in the Marvel Universe.

name: Iron Fist 1,000,000 BC
deck: Born one million years ago in the sacred city of K'un-Lun, Fan Fei was the first person ever to defeat the dragon Shou-Lao and win the power of the Iron Fist.

name: Iron Lad
deck: He is an adolescent version of Kang the Conqueror, armed with a bio-metal suit that responds to mental commands. He is responsible for assembling the Young Avengers. Even though being a human, his aging is slowed down, significantly.

name: Iron Man
deck: Tony Stark was the arrogant son of wealthy, weapon manufacturer Howard Stark. Tony cared only about himself, but he would have a change of heart after he was kidnapped by terrorists and gravely injured. Pressured to create a weapon of mass destruction, Stark instead created a suit of armor powerful enough for him to escape. Tony used his vast resources and intellect to make the world a better place as The Invincible Iron Man. Stark's super hero identity led him to become a founding member of the Avengers.

name: Iron-Hand Hauptmann
deck: A former Nazi and member of the Red Skull's villainous Exiles. Hauptmann wields a mechanical iron glove with abilities similar to the Satan Claw.

name: Ironclad
deck: Ironclad is a member of the U-Foes, a small group of criminals that tried to duplicate the crash that gave the Fantastic Four their powers. Ironclad never accepted that Hulk is stronger than him.

name: Ironheart
deck: A 15-year-old M.I.T. student and tech freak who built her own version of Iron Man armor from scratch.

name: ISAAC
deck: ISAAC is the near omniscient computer on Titan. All information travels through him to the residents and leaders.

name: Isabelle Hartley
deck: Isabelle Hartley was a SHIELD agent who was in relationship with Victoria Hand.

name: Iso
deck: Xiaoyi is a new Inhuman that was discovered by Reader in China.

name: J'son of Spartax
deck: Star-Lord's father and the former Emperor of the Spartoi Empire.

name: J. Jonah Jameson
deck: J. Jonah Jameson is the former employer of Peter B. Parker and remains an aggravate of Spider-Man. He was once the chief editor and publisher of the Daily Bugle, a New York newspaper, and the mayor of New York before his resignation amidst scandal resulting from Superior Spider Man and the Goblin Nation. He now is a host of a show on the F.A.C.T. News Channel

name: J2
deck: J2 is the son of Cain Marko, the Unstoppable Juggernaut, in the future timeline of Earth-982, (the MC2 universe.) He is a heroic member of his timeline's Avengers.

name: Jack Monroe
deck: A former sidekick to Captain America, Jack Monroe abandoned his mentor when he became disillusioned with the hero's lack of finite action against the super-villains they fought. He later became the notorious serial killer known as Scourge.

name: Jack O'Lantern
deck: A sadistic mercenary abducted as a kid by Crime-Master who raised him to be a stone-cold killer. He assumed the persona of Jack O'Lantern after killing all of the people who previously used this name.

name: Jack O'Lantern (Levins)
deck: Steven Mark Levins is one of several people to call themselves Jack O'Lantern. He has been an enemy to Captain America, Ghost Rider and the Punisher.

name: Jack of  Knives
deck: One of the four Eternals crimelords that form the Tricks.

name: Jack of Hearts
deck: The son of the scientist Philip Hart who created an energy source called "zero fluid" and Marie, an alien humanoid woman of the Contraxian race.

name: Jake Fury
deck: The angry younger brother of Nick Fury, Jake Fury has been known both as the criminal Scorpio and undercover as the terrorist leader Kraken.

name: James Rogers
deck: James is the son of Captain America & Black Widow. He has many abilities as his dad including his indestructible shield.

name: Jane Foster
deck: A nurse who assisted Thor (disguised as Dr. Donald Blake) and eventually fell in love with him. Despite being diagnosed with breast cancer, she took up the mantle of Thor when he was no longer deemed worthy, and eventually became the new Valkyrie and a member of The Avengers.

name: Jarvis
deck: Butler to the Stark family, Edwin Jarvis went on to be the caretaker of the Avengers Mansion and has laid his life on the line for them several times.

name: Jason Ionello
deck: Part the "popular crowd" along with Flash Thompson, Brian "Tiny" McKeever, Seymour O'Reilly, and Sally Avril who were often picking on Peter Parker.

name: Jasper Sitwell
deck: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent that was trained by Nick Fury personally. He was S.H.I.E.L.D.'s top interrogator and the sometimes partner of Jimmy Woo. Currently a zombie working for S.T.A.K.E.

name: Jean Grey
deck: Jean Grey was one of the five original X-Men. An omega-level mutant telepath and powerful telekinetic, Jean has gained near limitless powers as a recurrent host of the Phoenix Force. She is known for her return from death and as the wife of Cyclops.

name: Jeff Kaplan
deck: The adoptive Father of Billy Kaplan (Wiccan) and husband of Rebecca Kaplan. He is a Cardiologist by trade

name: Jennifer Ransome
deck: Girlfriend to Phillip Moreau and Genoshan ex-patriot

name: Jenny Leigh
deck: Kelsey Shorr Leigh's daugther (Lionheart).

name: Jeremy Logan
deck: The night clerk at the hotel Captain Marvel stayed in when he first came to Earth. Jeremy Logan figured out Mar-Vell was a spy.

name: Jerran Ko
deck: An Ex Nihilii who commits suicide and destroys a world.

name: Jessica Jones
deck: A superhero turned private invesitgator, Jessica is married to Luke Cage and is the mother of Danielle, their infant daughter.

name: Jester
deck: Former actor and criminal, there has been two different Jesters.

name: Jim Hammond
deck: The original Human Torch, who fought in the second World War and was a member of the Invaders, is a synthetic human created by Professor Phineas T. Horton. He is also (publishing-wise) the first ever Marvel super-hero!

name: Jim Shooter
deck: James Shooter (1951 - ) is comic book writer, occasional fill-in artist, editor, and publisher. He has appeared as a character in a number of stories.

name: Jimmy Hudson
deck: James "Jimmy" Hudson is the son of Wolverine and Magda Lensherr (Ultimate Universe) . After the events of Secret Wars he is now a resident of Earth 616. He was unfortunately a victim of the alien race, The Poisons.

name: Jinku
deck: Jinku is the witchdoctor of the lava men.

name: Jo-Venn
deck: Jo-Venn was a child gladiator force to represent the Kree in a mock Kree-Skrull War by The Profiteer, he was eventually saved by the Fantastic Four.

name: Jocasta
deck: Once the Bride of Ultron, Jocasta has become an honorary member of the Avengers after years of loyalty and sacrifice. She had until most recently held a position at The Avengers Academy.

name: Joey
deck: A young boy who befriends the amnesiac Black Bolt. His hair inexplicably changes from black to red.

name: John I of England
deck: Commonly known as Prince John, he ruled England.

name: John Jameson
deck: John Jameson is an astronaut, a test pilot and for his father J. Jonah Jameson the archetype of a true hero unlike these “masked clowns” like Spider-man. John has also been transformed into a Werewolf-like creature called the Man-Wolf, and was once host to the Carnage Symbiote.

name: Johnny Carson
deck: Here's Johnnnny! Host of The Tonight Show on NBC from 1962-1992.

name: Jolt
deck: Receiving her powers from Arnim Zola's cruel experimentation, Helen Takahama joined the original Thunderbolts team as Jolt, unaware of their hidden agenda. She still managed to become a fine hero in her own right, and helped several other members of the Thunderbolts do likewise.

name: Jonas Hale
deck: Long-time member of Roxxon, Hale posed a threat to the likes of superheroes as Spider-Man and Iron Man as a minor villain.

name: Jonathan Drew
deck: A scientist and father of Spider-Woman

name: Jonathan Tremont
deck: Leader of the Triune Understanding Cult

name: Jonz Rickard
deck: Jonz Rickard is a corrupt descendant of Rick Jones from the 26th Century and is the leader of Galactic Avenger Battalion Theta-4. Like his ancestor Jonz is a wielder of The Destiny Force but has far greater control over it.

name: Joseph
deck: Joseph was a younger clone of Magneto, created by Astra. He sacrificed himself to repair Earth's magnetosphere, which had been altered by Magneto. He has recently returned to cause trouble for the redemptive Magneto.

name: Joshua Walker
deck: Joshua Walker is the father of Patsy Walker, the super-heroin known as Hellcat.

name: Joystick
deck: Joystick is a former member of the Masters of Evil and the Thunderbolts. While with the Thunderbolts, it was discovered that Joystick was a double agent working for the Grandmaster and her objective was to steal the Moonstones of Baron Zemo.

name: Jubilee
deck: Jubilee is a long-time member of the X-Men and founding member of Generation X. She previously lost her mutant powers on M-Day, and then was turned into a vampire. Most recently, she re-gained her pyrotechnic abilities and was turned back into a mutant .

name: Juggernaut
deck: Cain Marko, also known as the Juggernaut, is the step-brother of X-Men founder Charles Xavier and the avatar of Cyttorak. Powered by the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak, Marko is bestowed virtually limitless brute strength and durability which he mostly uses for criminal pursuits and wanton destruction. The Juggernaut is considered one of the strongest and most powerful beings on Earth.

name: Julia Carpenter
deck: Julia Carpenter is the second heroine to take up the mantle of Spider-Woman, later changing her name to Arachne. After the events of the Grim Hunt she became the new Madame Web and is currently a watcher and guardian of the Spyders.

name: Julia Winters
deck: Julia Winters was a baby girl adopted by Nomad. Her mother was a drug addict who could not take care of her. Nomad named her Bucky and attempted to raise her.

name: Justice
deck: Vance Astrovik is a mutant with the power of Telekinesis. He first called himself Marvel Boy but later changed his name to Justice. His is a founding member of the New Warriors, fulfilled his dream of becoming an Avengers and helped train young heroes at the Avengers Academy.

name: Justin Hammer
deck: A longtime foe of Iron Man who as a criminal mastermind employed super-villains and organized criminal operations.

name: K'eel
deck: K'eel was a skrull living on Hy'lt Minor when it was attacked by the Builders.

name: Ka-Zar
deck: The son of an English nobleman, Ka-Zar grew up in the Savage Land alongside his loyal partner/surrogate parent Zabu after the death of his father.

name: Kalxor
deck: A skrull armada commander who encountered the Avengers in space during the Kree/Skrull War.

name: Kamala Khan
deck: A polymorphic Pakistani-American teenager from New Jersey who, when exposed to the Terrigen Mists, became Ms. Marvel. She is an Inhuman/Mutant hybrid and a founding member of the adolescent superhero team The Champions. Kamala is a huge superhero fan with an endless supply of optimism.

name: Kang
deck: A time-traveling conqueror with vast powers and technological supremacy, Kang the Conqueror has taken every opportunity to torment the Marvel Universe, and is one of the Avengers' greatest foes. Kang has amassed an empire with a citizenry of millions, and cut a swath of terror through the ages with his various aliases like: Rama-Tut, Immortus, Scarlet Centurion, Iron Lad, and Myrddin.

name: Karen Page
deck: Secretary at Matt Murdock's law firm and long time love interest. She was eventually killed by Bullseye when she sacrificed herself for Matt.

name: Karma
deck: Karma is a mutant with the ability to mentally possess other beings. A founding member of the New Mutants, she is one of the few confirmed and openly lesbian characters. She lost a leg and now has a cybernetic one in its place.

name: Karnak
deck: A member of the Attilan Royal Family and Magister of the Tower of Wisdom. Karnak is a philosopher and master martial artist trained in the extrasensory ability to find the weakness or fault in any object, person or idea.

name: Kate Bishop
deck: Inspired by Clint Barton, Kate took up the mantle of Hawkeye and became a member of the Young Avengers. When Clint returned, the two of them struck up an on-again, off-again partnership, with Clint supporting her as she becomes more and more involved in the world of the Avengers.

name: Katie Summers
deck: The human daughter of Havok and Wasp born on the mutant utopia of Planet X, after the Apocalypse Twins brought on the destruction of Earth.

name: Khonshu
deck: The Egyptian God of the Moon, and protector of those who travel by night. His disciples and avatars on Earth are the Fists of Khonshu, with the most famous being the costumed crime fighter called Moon Knight.

name: Kid Colt
deck: One of Marvel's greatest western crimefighters, as well as the star of America's longest-running Cowboy comic book.

name: Killpower
deck: Killpower was genetically engineered by Mys-Tech's mad scientist Dr. Oonagh Mullarkey as a prototype fast-growing, throwaway super-soldier; tough, strong and not too bright, Motormouth's friendship made him a hero.

name: Killraven
deck: A warrior from Earth-691, Killraven led a group known as the Freemen against the tyranny of Earth's Martian Masters.

name: King Arthur
deck: King Arthur, the Once and Future king.

name: King Cobra
deck: Dutch criminal with Cobra like powers, who went on as the third leader of The Serpent Society.

name: King Richard the Lion-Hearted
deck: Eighth ruler of the Kingdom of England.

name: Kingo Sunen
deck: He has has all the powers of the Eternals.

name: Kirren
deck: Kirren is an Inhuman guard.

name: Kiru
deck: Kiru was a citizen of Galador that died during the Builders' attack.

name: Kismet
deck: Formerly known as "Paragon," then as "Her," Kismet is an artificial life-form created by the Enclave and intended to be the mate of Him (Adam Warlock).

name: Kitty Pryde
deck: Kitty Pryde (a.k.a. Shadowcat) is a mutant gifted with the ability to become intangible and phase her entire body through solid material. A talented prodigy, she became the poster child of the X-Men; eventually reaching maturation and becoming the team's current leader.

name: Klaw
deck: Ulysses Klaw is a Dutch scientist and an arch enemy to Black Panther. He has a gun on his arm that turns sound into images. His body was converted into pure sound when he jumped into his sound converter machine.

name: Kluh
deck: Kluh who was originally intended to be the genetically altered and "improved" clone of Hulk created by Xemnu the Living Titan. However in current issues of the AXIS event Kluh is referred as the inverted version of Hulk, which contrary to Hulk's rage-based powers, this Hulk version becomes what it is by sadness and depression.

name: Knull
deck: Knull ruled the primordial universe alone until the arrival of the Celestials, who began filling his domain with matter, light and life. He went to war against them and their creations to return the universe to the dark void, creating many powerful weapons to aid him, including the Necrosword and the Klyntar symbiotes.

name: Kobik
deck: A combination of Cosmic Cube fragments that assumed the shape of a little girl. Initially used by S.H.I.E.L.D. to create Pleasant Hill.

name: Kofi Annan
deck: A Secretary-General of the United Nations.

name: Kona Lor
deck: She is second of command of Galen-Kor's Lunatic Legion

name: Korath the Pursuer
deck: Korath the Pursuer was a Kree cyber-geneticist, former member of the Kree Starforce and the first Phalanx Select.

name: Korg
deck: Korg is a Kronan warrior from the planet Ria that becomes a member of the Hulk's Warbound.

name: Korvac
deck: A denizen of the 31st century, Korvac betrayed humanity to Badoon invaders and became the enemy of the Guardians of the Galaxy. Gaining untold power from the Worldship of Galactus, he then traveled back in time to become an enemy of the Avengers as well as a threat to the entire universe.

name: Krakkan
deck: An armored warrior-like being. One of the members of the Octessence.

name: Krakoa
deck: Krakoa is the island that walks like a man, a living island mutant in the middle of the pacific ocean spawned from nuclear experiments. Later, Krakoa would be tamed by Xavier and Magneto and serve as the a new island nation refuge for all of Earth's mutants.

name: Krang
deck: Warlord Krang is a nobleman of Atlantis and a long time foe of Prince Namor the Sub-Mariner.

name: Kratos
deck: God of power. Wields an adamantine sword.

name: Kraven the Hunter
deck: A famous big game hunter, who became a mercenary and later, developed an intense obsession with restoring honor to his name. Kraven has been known as a major threat for Spider-Man and leaving a legacy during his demise.

name: Kray-Tor
deck: Kray-Tor was once a corupt judge in the Church of Truth before being trapped in the Soul World

name: Kree Giant-Man
deck: An alternate-reality counterpart of Giant-Man from an Earth dominated by the Kree. According to the Thing, this Giant-Man has all the powers of Hank Pym but none of his moves.

name: Kristoff Vernard
deck: Kristoff Vernard is the adopted son of Victor Von Doom and heir to the Latverian throne.

name: Kro
deck: Kro is a well-known shape-shifting Deviant and love-interest to the Eternal known as Thena. Because of his love for her, Kro sometimes became a relunctant ally of the Eternals.

name: Kronos
deck: A mysterious and rarely seen Eternal, the cosmic master of time within the Marvel continuum remains a powerful figure within the universe's large landscape. Once a Titan when the universe was young - he now resides between the space/time continuum as an ominous figure observing matters of galactic importance.

name: Krushki
deck: Russian member of the villainous Exiles. He is a powerful wrestler who makes it a point not to use weapons other than his own body.

name: Kulan Gath
deck: Kulan Gath was a villainous magician and sorcerer in Earth's Hyborian Era.

name: Kurrgo
deck: Using a mentally-controlled robot, this unearthly ruler of a subjugated planet once caused the people of Earth to turn against the Fantastic Four! Kurrgo, the master of Planet X!

name: Kurt Busiek
deck: Comic book writer.

name: Kuurth
deck: Kuurth, Breaker of Stone, is one of The Serpent's Worthy. He was in possession of The Juggernaut's body during Fear Itself and was using it to wreak havoc and instill fear across the United States.

name: Kwannon
deck: Kwannon is a Japanese assassin for the Hand, who was body-swapped with the X-Man Betsy Braddock. Living in the body of Betsy, she assumed the codename "Revanche" and briefly joined the X-Men before dying of the Legacy Virus. She was later resurrected in her original body and is now the current Psylocke.

name: Lactuca the Knower
deck: Lactuca is an Omega-level mutant from Arakko with the power to know the location of anything in the universe.

name: Lady Deathstrike
deck: Lady Deathstrike is a super-villain in the Marvel Universe and is most commonly associated with Wolverine and the X-Men.

name: Lady Lark
deck: The tragic lady with the voice of a lark, violated by villain and friend alike, now reborn into a raptor in the skies for justice.

name: Lady of the Lake
deck: The Celtic goddess of lakes.

name: Lady Ursula
deck: Circus bear evolved into humanoid by High Evolutionary.

name: Lancelot
deck: The Star, member of Myrddin's Twilight Court

name: Larry King
deck: Larry King is an actual person who has his own news show.

name: Lascivious
deck: The first Titania, a member of the Grapplers. She was slain by the Scourge, then revived by The Hood in order to kill the Punisher.

name: Lavin Skee
deck: Lavin Skee was of an alien race known as the Imperials on the planet Sakaar.

name: Layla Miller
deck: Originally a key figure in the House of M, Layla Miller is a mutant who joined X-Factor Investigations after M-Day and eventually married its founder, Jamie Madrox. She is famous for her catch phrase "I know stuff", which stems from her comprehensive knowledge of future events.

name: Lazaer
deck: Lazaer is seen every time Wolverine has a near-death experience. Wolverine talks about having to fight Lazaer for his life every time this happens. Lazaer uses a huge sword to fight with. Wolverine seems to have killed Lazaer when they were both alive.

name: Leap-Frog
deck: Leap-Frog, former criminal and father of the costumed hero, Frog-Man.

name: Lectronn
deck: Originally created as a Marvel Age April Fool's joke, the character has been used in several appearances in "normal" continuity.

name: Legion
deck: The son of Charles Xavier and Gabrielle Haller, David Haller is the powerful Omega-level mutant known as Legion. He possesses hundreds of mutant abilities ranging from telekinesis to reality warping, but each power is controlled by a different persona, which could be either benevolent or malevolent.

name: Lei Kung
deck: The immortal teacher of the legacy of Iron Fist.

name: Leo (Radford)
deck: Leo is a member of Zodiac

name: Leonard McKenzie
deck: Father of Namor. He would fall in love with Princess Fen, the future mother of Namor.

name: Letha
deck: Formerly a member of the Grapplers, Letha was slain by the Scourge of the Underworld during the Bar With No Name massacre. She was later revived by the Hood, who gave her rage-inducing powers.

name: Lex Luthor
deck: Lex Luthor, Superman's arch-nemesis, is one of the most brilliant men alive, whose hatred of "interfering aliens" pushes him down the path of a sociopath. Known for his "ends justifies the means" approach to life, his single-minded and often brutal focus puts him at odds with the Man of Steel. Luthor is arguably DC's most iconic villain.

name: Libra (Brandt)
deck: Member of Zodiac

name: Lightbright
deck: Lightbright is a Somalian mutant who has been a heroine, a mercenary, and a terrorist in her few appearances.

name: Lilandra
deck: Once the Majestrix of the Shi'ar Imperium and a former romantic partner of Charles Xavier. She was deposed by Vulcan and assassinated while attempting to take back her empire.

name: Lin Sun
deck: Lin Sun is a master martial artist and member of the Sons of the Tiger.

name: Linda Carter
deck: A student night nurse, Linda Carter started aiding superheroes in need of medical care and began dating Doctor Strange.

name: Lindy Reynolds
deck: Lindy Reynolds was the wife of Robert Reynolds, the superhero better known as The Sentry.

name: Ling McPherson
deck: Ling McPherson was a bodyguard and a partner with Bethany Cabe of the firm Cabe & McPherson, Security Specialists. She became a supporting character in the first Iron Man series.

name: Lionheart
deck: Kelsey was killed by Thunderball and resurrected by Captain Britain. She then had a brief stint with the Avengers.

name: Living Laser
deck: Arthur Parks was a brilliant scientist in the field of laser research and design. He became a career criminal using laser technology, and then a being of pure living energy. He is an Iron Man enemy.

name: Living Lightning
deck: Miguel Santos became Living Lightning, a being of electric energy after investigating one of his terrorist father's illegal experiments to seize control of the country. After a brief career as a misguided villain, Living Lightning became a member of the Avengers until eventually retiring from the team to enroll in college. Living Lightning remains active as a hero, balancing college work with heroism and is currently a member of the Rangers.

name: Living Mummy
deck: N'Kantu is a mummified African tribesman with heightened strength and dexterity. He is also considered immortal due to his "life" of over 3,000 years.

name: Liz Allan
deck: Elizabeth Allan was a classmate of Peter Parker. She dated and later married Harry Osborn. She has a son named Normie Osborn and is now the CEO of Alchemax.

name: Lizard
deck: During an experiment, Dr. Curtis Connors accidentally turned himself into a ferocious reptilian monster who seeks to turn humans into lizards like himself. The Lizard is one of Spider-Man’s oldest and deadliest foes while ironically, his alter ego is a close friend and former teacher of Spidey’s alter ego, Peter Parker.

name: Loa
deck: Loa is a mutant with the ability to dissolve the molecular bonds of anything she touches. She also gained the ability to breathe underwater from an Atlantean Amulet that her grandmother obtained from her friend who was Namor's old girlfriend.

name: Lockheed
deck: Lockheed is a purple, winged, quadrupedal alien that resembles a small dragon. He is the longtime companion of Kitty Pryde with whom he shares a special bond. He is a valued member of the X-Men and founding member of The Pet Avengers.

name: Lockjaw
deck: An Inhuman dog with the abilities of incredible teleportaton feats as well as other abilities. Serving the Inhuman Royal Family as their escort and teleportation means, Lockjaw is a loyal protector.

name: Loki
deck: Loki is the Jötunn/Asgardian God of Mischief and Prince of Lies, the adopted son of Odin and typically nemesis of his brother, Thor. Loki has schemed against Thor and Asgard for ages and his cosmic meddling led to the formation of the Avengers. Recently reincarnated, he decided to reform. Going on to protect the realms as the agent of Asgard, then as the sorcerer supreme, to defeating Laufey and becoming king of Jotunnheim.

name: Lord Anon
deck: Evolved red wolf and Knight of Wungadore

name: Lord Chaos
deck: The living embodiment of Chaos.

name: Lord Ennui
deck: A connoisseur member of the Ashen Combine

name: Lord Gator
deck: An evolved alligator.

name: Lord Templar
deck: Brother to John Tremont and Pagan.

name: Lord Tyger
deck: Evolved tiger.

name: Lorelei Travis
deck: Lorelei Travis is one of The 198. Her power is prehensile hair and her first appearance was District X #1.

name: Lotus Shinchuko
deck: The woman who caused the Sons of the Tiger to disband.

name: Lucian Von Doom
deck: In a divergent 2099 reality, Lucian is the succesesor of the original doctor doom and the master of the Black Panther.

name: Lucifer
deck: An alien who cost Professor X the use of his legs.

name: Luke Cage
deck: Luke Cage, wrongly convicted and unjustly imprisoned, was altered in a failed prison experiment that granted him unbreakable skin and superhuman strength. With his street smarts and unending determination to do right, he fights for the common man! He eventually married Jessica Jones and had a daughter with her.

name: Luna
deck: The daughter of Quicksilver and Crystal, Luna is a member of the Inhuman Royal Family and recently joined Polaris's All-New X-Factor.

name: Luther Manning
deck: Manning was a high ranking officer in the world's US Army. When he was wounded in battle, he was transformed into the cyborg known as Deathlok.

name: M
deck: Monet St. Croix, also known as 'M', was originally a founding member of Generation X, later involved with various X-Men related teams.

name: M'Shulla
deck: Member Of Killraven's Freemen who is a skilled crossbow user.

name: M-11
deck: A human consciousness within the metallic body of a humanoid robot, better known as M-11, teammember of the Agents of Atlas.

name: M.O.D.O.K.
deck: M.O.D.O.K. is an acronym for Mental Organism Designed Only for Killing. He has a plethora of psychic powers, which he used to take control of A.I.M.

name: M.O.D.O.K. 2.0
deck: A clone of the original M.O.D.O.K. created by A.I.M. who currently works for S.H.I.E.L.D.

name: Machine Man
deck: The sole surviving robot of a government project, X-51 had the benefits of humanity by being raised as a son by Dr. Abel Stack. Dubbed "Machine Man", he became a superhero and later an Avenger until being corrupted by Sentinel technology and developing a strong dislike for humans. Now, he stands for all artificially intelligent beings right to be considered sentient.

name: Mad Thinker
deck: A scientist who believes in predicting the future with math.

name: Mad-Dog
deck: A former US Air Force member, ex-husband to Patsy Walker: Robert Baxter is now the costumed criminal known as Mad-Dog.

name: Madame Death
deck: 1940's crimeboss and partner of Future Man.

name: Madame Masque
deck: Raised as a wealthy socialite, Whitney Frost was initially horrified to learn of her true heritage as the daughter of the Maggia-leader Count Nefaria. Hiding her face behind a golden mask after horrible scarring, she has been driven mostly by vengeance against her father which has placed her on both sides of the law.

name: Madelyne Pryor
deck: Madelyne Pryor is Cyclops's first wife, Cable's mother, and a clone of Jean Grey created by Mr. Sinister. After Cyclops abandoned her and her son, she was tricked and seduced by demons to harness great demonic power.

name: Madison Jeffries
deck: Madison Jeffries is a mutant with the power to psionically restructure metal, plastic, and glass.

name: Madrox
deck: Jamie Madrox, also known as Multiple Man, is a mutant with the ability to create duplicates of himself through physical contact. These "dupes" can later be reabsorbed, along with all of their memories and experiences. Best known for his X-Factor history, he recently rejoined the newly reformed X-Corporation.

name: Maestro
deck: The Hulk's future counterpart, a true tyrant in every sense. He survived the great apocalyptic war and proceeded to kill the remaining heroes and villains that dared to oppose him. He possesses the intelligence that is equal to or greater than Bruce Banner, while also possessing enhanced power that is greater than that of the Hulk.

name: Magda Eisenhardt
deck: Magda was Magneto's wife, and mother of his children; the late Anya and twins Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch. More recently, it was hinted that Magda was not really the twins' mother.

name: Magdalene
deck: Magdalene was a hero from a different reality and later became an honorary member of the Avengers

name: Mageth
deck: An elfin healer with empathic abilities.

name: Magik
deck: The younger sister of Colossus. Illyana Rasputin is a mutant teleporter, advanced sorceress, and the former ruler of Limbo. She has been a long standing New Mutant and recurring member of the X-Men, and once stood as a War Captain of Krakoa.

name: Magma
deck: Magma can transform into molten rock & has control over the Earth. She was one of the New Mutants, but left to join the Hellions. She has since been a teacher at the Xavier Institute and rejoined her teammates from the New Mutants.

name: Magna Mind
deck: A thief with an obsession for conundrums.

name: Magneto
deck: Among the most powerful, recognizable, and infamous mutants to inhabit the planet Earth, Magneto was the X-Men's first major nemesis. Now known as a revolutionist and terrorist, Magneto has fought for the X-Men as many times as he’s been against them.

name: Magus
deck: The evil doppleganger of Adam Warlock, Magus believes Good and Evil are tools to chain sentient beings. His goal is to give all lifeforms a purpose: To Worship him or Die.

name: Mainframe
deck: Mainframe is a sentient computer program based upon Tony Stark's brainwaves and is one of the founding members of A-Next.

name: Majeston Zelia
deck: Majeston Zelia is the ruler of the Dark Gods and a major enemy of Odin.

name: Major Victory
deck: The leader and founder of the Guardians of the Galaxy in the year 3000. He carries the legendary shield of Captain America.

name: Makkari
deck: Makkari is an Eternal who specializes in speed.

name: Mal Donalbain
deck: Donalbain was the megalomaniac responsible for the creation of the Cat.

name: Malachi
deck: A servant of Kang who was presumed to be one of the Scarlet Witch's children.

name: Malefactor
deck: The son of Dr. Doom and Enchantress from earth 9811.

name: Malpractice
deck: Malpractice is a member of Hydra's D.O.A. and an enemy of the Midnight Sons.

name: Man-Ape
deck: M'Baku is a worshipper of the sacred White Gorilla who was exiled from Wakanda because of his actions in leading the cult and betraying The Black Panther. A sacred ritual gives him apelike strength, agility and stamina, earning him the name Man-Ape.

name: Man-Killer
deck: A villain formerly known as Man-Killer, she loosely reformed and re-established herself as Amazon among the Thunderbolts.

name: Man-Thing
deck: Man-Thing is a powerful swamp creature and guardian of the Nexus of all Realities. He was once human and turned himself into a monster as a last act of defense and a way too avoid his serum falling in the wrong hands.

name: Mandarin
deck: The Mandarin is the arch enemy of Iron Man. A remarkable genius with both earthly and extraterrestrial technology, the Mandarin is also an exceptional athlete, swordsman, and martial artist.

name: Mangog
deck: Mangog is a tulpa begotten of the fury from a mysterious Alien race. Supposedly said to be the manifestation of their unending fury towards Odin and Asgard born of the combined hatred of these billion billion murdered beings. Mangog is a powerful enemy of Odin, a dire threat to Asgard, and one of Thor's deadliest foes.

name: Manifold
deck: A mutant of Australian aboriginal descent with the ability to bend reality and twist space-time for teleportation.

name: Manta
deck: Manta is a long-standing member of the Imperial Guard, currently serving under Gladiator, the ruler of the Shi'ar empire. She perceives her environment through infrared vision, and can generate blasts of intense light, heat, and concussive force from her wings, which also allow her to fly.

name: Mantis
deck: From Avenger to cosmic traveler to the legendary Celestial Madonna, Mantis is perhaps one of the most well-traveled characters in the Marvel Universe.

name: Marcus Immortus
deck: Marcus Immortus is the son of Immortus and Revelation, who used mind control to make Ms. Marvel fall in love with him.

name: Marcus Kang
deck: Marcus Kang is the son of the time-travelling world conqueror known as Kang.

name: Margali Szardos
deck: The self-proclaimed Sorceress Supreme of Earth and Mistress of the Winding Way, she is morally ambiguous, often using black magick for good intent and, although her true origins remain a mystery, Margali is a powerful witch-priestess with a familial heritage of magick and healing. Margali is the foster-mother of Kurt Wagner, Nightcrawler as well as mother of Jimaine Szardos, AKA Amanda Sefton, Magicienne.

name: Margus
deck: Brother of Korg.

name: Maria  Hill
deck: Maria Hill was the Director of S.H.I.E.L.D. after Nick Fury went awol. During the Heroic Age she acted as supervising liason for The Avengers, and was a key player in the Secret Empire event.

name: Maria Rambeau
deck: Maria Rambeau is the wife of Frank Rambeau and mother of Monica Rambeau (Photon). She is very supportive of her daughter.

name: Maria Trovaya Pym
deck: Maria Trovaya Pym was the first wife of Hank Pym and the mother of Nadia Pym.

name: Marie Antoinette
deck: Marie Antoinette, born Maria Antonia Josepha Johanna was the last Queen of France before the French Revolution.

name: Marie Danvers
deck: Mother of Carol Danvers

name: Marrina
deck: Marrina is a member of the Plodex alien race. Raised on Earth, she becomes a member of Alpha Flight before she marries Namor the Sub-Mariner and becomes a member of the Avengers.

name: Marrow
deck: A mutant able to control her bone growth, providing her with armor, clubs, and knives. As a child, she was taken in by the Morlocks where she would form the terrorist group Gene Nation before joining the X-Men. Her allegiances have shifted frequently since then. She was once de-powered after M-Day.

name: Martin Leigh
deck: Kelsey Shorr Leigh's son (Lionheart). He is Captain America fan.

name: Martinex
deck: Sole survivor of his race, Martinex is genetically capable of withstanding extreme conditions due to the environment of his home planet Pluto and has the ability to blast heat rays from his right hand and ice beams with his left. Meeting other survivors who also had their homes destroyed by the evil alien race of Badoon, Martinex formed the Guardians of the Galaxy in the 31st century to defeat them and continued on to create a larger group known as the Galactic Guardians.

name: Mary Jane
deck: Mary Jane Watson is an actress and a major love interest of Peter Parker aka Spider-Man. They have had a long and dramatic on-and-off-again relationship. She's one of the few people who know who he is and still supports him as a close friend and confidante.

name: Marya Maximoff
deck: Marya is, apparently, the aunt of the Scarlet Witch and Quicksilver. She had raised them, but until recently it was believed that Magda and Erik (Magneto) Lensherr where the twins' biological parents.

name: Master Man
deck: Master Man was a frail Nazi powered by the Super Soldier Serum who fought Captain America in World War II.

name: Master of the World
deck: The Master is a super-villain and an arch-nemesis of Alpha Flight.

name: Master Order
deck: The living embodiment of Order.

name: Master Pandemonium
deck: A supernatural villain responsible for stealing the souls of the Scarlet Witch's twin children.

name: Mastermind
deck: Founding member of the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants, Jason Wyngarde was the original Mastermind. He was instrumental in the creation of Dark Phoenix, ruining Wolverine's relationship with Mariko Yashida and later died of the Legacy Virus. His two daughters have inherited his telepathic illusionary powers and name.

name: Match
deck: Once a student at the Xavier Institute where Match was appointed squad leader of the Paragons. Match retained his powers after M-Day. He is currently enrolled at the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning.

name: Matriarch
deck: The Matriarch is the assistant to the leader of the Universal Church of Truth, the Magus. Whenever the Magus is not active, the Matriarch takes the position of power. There have been several Matriarchs of the Church.

name: Maul
deck: Former member of The Order, the initiative team of California. He was fired from the team because of a scandal.

name: Maxie Shiffman
deck: Maxie Shiffman was Spider-Man's agent. He later became a temporary pawn of Mysterio.

name: Maximus
deck: Maximus is the genius and insane brother of Black Bolt who often plots against the Inhuman Royal Family. Recently, he has been cooperating with the Royal Family under Medusa's rule.

name: Maz
deck: Badoon warrior who invaded Jupiter

name: Mechamage
deck: An ally of the Fantatsic Four.

name: Medusa
deck: Medusa is the Queen of the Inhumans and the primary interpreter for her husband Black Bolt, the King of the Inhumans. Medusa is best known for her long, thick head of red hair, which she can psychokinetically wield like countless extra appendages.

name: Megan McLaren
deck: Megan McLaren was a television reporter who covered various news regarding the Thunderbolts and the Avengers

name: Meggan
deck: Meggan is an empathic metamorph. She is a founding member of Excalibur and the wife of Brian Braddock aka Captain Britain.

name: Megrim
deck: Member of The Bloodcoven, a vampire who feeds on thoughts

name: Meld
deck: Former member of the U.S. army's Sentinel Squad O*N*E, Meld is a mutant active in mutant rights.

name: Melter (Horgan)
deck: Bruno Horgan is a former competitor of Tony Stark. He becomes the Melter and is considered one of Iron Man's deadliest foes. The Melter is eventually killed by the Scourge of the Underworld.

name: Mentallo
deck: Marvin Flumm was one of the first S.H.I.E.L.D. agents to go bad. Using his mental powers under the alias of Mentallo, he turned on S.H.I.E.L.D. along with his partner in crime, the Fixer.

name: Mentor
deck: A'lars - descendant of the Titan Kronos, Father to the Demi-Gods Thanos and Eros, Grandfather of Thane. Mentor, more commonly referred to as The Mentor, became the founder of the colony orbiting the planet of Saturn. Engineer, physicist, father - The Mentor would shape many cosmic characters.

name: Mentor
deck: Mentor is a super-intelligent member of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard, possibly an android or cyborg.

name: Mephisto
deck: A sadistic, cruel, and dangerous extra-dimensional demon with unknown origins, Mephisto is incredibly powerful. Based on Mephistopheles, a demon from the Faust legend, Mephisto is known for stealing souls and torturing them in his hell-like dimension. He is one of the many Hell-Lords in the Marvel Universe.

name: Mercurio
deck: Half-transformed alien from the planet Gramos

name: Mercury
deck: A former member of the Hellions training squad, Mercury was a junior member of the X-Men. Her mutant power transformed her entire body into living liquid metal. Although continually struggling to accept her mutant form, she has made strong friendships with other young mutants under the X-Men's care. She is currently enrolled at the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning.

name: Meridian Diadem
deck: The most dangerous of the Ashen Combine, for she does not discriminate

name: Merlyn
deck: Merlyn is the sorcerer supreme of the Otherworld and father to Roma.

name: Metal Master
deck: Alien from the planet Astra and one of Hulk's first foes.

name: Michael Pointer
deck: Michael Pointer is a mutant with the power to absorb other superhuman energies and powers. He was unaware of being a mutant until all the lost powers from M-Day selected him as a host. In this state he accidentally murdered Alpha Flight. He has been trying to make amends since but has almost constantly been manipulated by others.

name: Michelle
deck: Fellow student of Ulysses Cain, she also passed through Terrigenesis.

name: Microbe
deck: Mutant member of the New Warriors with the ability to communicate with germs. He was the adopted son of Night Thrasher, and co-starred in the New Warriors' reality television show when they confronted Nitro in Stamford. Consequently, Microbe died in the explosion that kick-started the Civil War.

name: Micromax
deck: Micromax is a size changing mutant trained as a British spy.

name: Midgard Serpent
deck: An enormous serpent that wraps around Midgard, Jormungand is an enemy of Asgard. In the prophecy of Ragnarok, Thor and the Midgard Serpent are destined to both die in battle with one another. As per its nickname, Jormungand covers the entire planet from head to tail.

name: Midnight Sun
deck: Once enemies, after their last battle Silver Surfer and Midnight Sun left each other on amicable terms.

name: Miek
deck: Miek is an insectoid warrior, one of the last of his kind from the planet Sakaar. He becomes warbound with the Hulk during Planet Hulk.

name: Mikaboshi
deck: Amatsu-Mikaboshi is the Japanese god of chaos and evil, an aspect of Oblivion. His goal was to put an end to creation and bring about a new age of chaos and void. After almost destroying the Multiverse, he was sealed off to a realm, where he dwells in a endless nothingess for all of eternity.

name: Miles Morales
deck: Originally created in the Ultimate Universe, this version of Spider-Man is a 16 year old kid named Miles Morales from Brooklyn who takes on the Spider-Man identity after Peter Parker's death. Miles discovers spider powers of his own after he was bitten by a spider 11 months before Peter's death, and uses these powers to be the best superhero he can be. Currently, Miles lives in the main Marvel Universe and is a member of the Champions.

name: Mimic
deck: Mimic is a super-human with the ability to copy the powers and abilities of others. He was the first new recruit to the original X-Men team and later a member of the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants, Excalibur and Norman Osborn's X-Men team before rejoining the X-Men at the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning.

name: Mindee Cuckoo
deck: Irma, also known as Mindee is one of the Stepford Cuckoos, clones of Emma Frost created by the Weapon Plus program. She is currently residing at The White Palace in Krakoa.

name: Miracle Man
deck: "How do you fight a man who can accomplish miracles! That was the problem which confronted the Fantastic Four when they faced the threat of the Miracle Man... The Fantastic Four discovered that even miracles are not always what they seem... not when they are produced by a master hypnotist!"

name: Miriam Drew
deck: Miriam is the mother of Spider Woman.

name: Miriam Sharpe
deck: The mother of Damien Sharpe, one of the children who died in the Stamford incident. She became an activist urging for superhumans to be registered.

name: Miss America
deck: Miss America was a Golden Age hero and part of the superhero teams the Invaders and the All-Winners Squad.

name: Misty Knight
deck: A former NYPD cop with a bionic arm, martial arts skills, and an attitude who was involved with the Heroes for Hire operation for years.

name: Mockingbird
deck: Dr. Barbara "Bobbi" Morse is an agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. and a founding member of West Coast Avengers. She's an excellent spy and biochemist.

name: Modred the Mystic
deck: A magician with tutorship from Chthon, Modred the Mystic possesses immense mystical abilities, especially when in contact with the Darkhold.

name: Moira MacTaggert
deck: Moira MacTaggert was once one of the world's leading authorities on genetic mutation and she has been revealed to be a mutant with the ability to reincarnate.

name: Mokk
deck: The breaker of Faith was one of the seven spirits who served Cul. Member of the Worthy.

name: Mole Man
deck: The Mole Man! A nearly blind inhabitant of the nether regions of Earth! Using his strange "radar sense" instead of eyesight, aided by an awesome group of underearth monsters, this bitter, brooding man years ago left Earth's surface because of his hatred for mankind, and set up an underground empire!

name: Molecule Man
deck: An immensely powerful and chronically insecure character, Owen Reece has the power to control all matter and energy. Although often cast as a misunderstood villain, he has also at times acted as a hero.

name: Molto
deck: A Huge Lava like monster who was one of the first creatures to battle Thor when he came to earth.

name: Monica Rambeau
deck: After being exposed to extra-dimensional energy, Lt. Monica Rambeau gained the ability to manipulate all energies of the electromagnetic spectrum. She has gone by many code-names over the years whilst utilizing these abilities as a crime fighter. Monica has served alongside the Avengers in various incarnations and operated as their leader for a time.

name: Monmouth
deck: Monmouth is a member of Madame Masque's Inner Guard.

name: Monolith
deck: Robot modeled after Giant Man.

name: Monster of Badoon
deck: The Monster of Badoon is the greatest weapon of the Brotherhood of the Badoon

name: Monstrom
deck: Marvel Monster whom threatened humanity!

name: Moomba
deck: Moomba is a giant alien imprisoned on Earth and eventually put into the hands of an African tribe.

name: Moon Boy
deck: Part of the Moon Boy and Devil Dinosaur duo

name: Moon Girl
deck: Luna is an Inhuman girl with a genius-level intellect who befriends Devil Dinosaur.

name: Moon Knight
deck: Moon Knight, Marc Spector, Steven Grant, and Jake Lockley: four different aspects of the same man who was resurrected by Khonshu (the Egyptian Lunar-God of Vengeance and Justice) to serve as his "avatar." Those unjust mortals who prey upon the innocents traveling at night, with powers that come from the moon, beware the Vengeance of the Moon Knight!

name: Moon Knight 1,000,000 BC
deck: The first Fist of Khonshu, originally chosen to stand against the Avengers 1,000,000 BC

name: Moondragon
deck: Moondragon is a powerful telekinetic and telepath, as well as the daughter of Arthur Douglas (better known as Drax). She once possessed the Mind Gem, one of the six Infinity Gems. Although she is a cold, shrewd loner at heart, she was almost always a member of a superhero team.

name: Moonraker
deck: Believing himself to be their former ally Libra, the man known as Moonraker aided the Avengers during The Crossing and unintentionally corrupted history concerning himself, making things resemble what he believed to be true.

name: Moonstar
deck: A Native American and member of the original New Mutants, Dani Moonstar was one of many mutants to lose their powers on M-Day, but has since had them restored. Moonstar currently uses her skills, experience and combat prowess to fight against evil as Hel's Valkyrie and has been a member of the New Mutants, MLF, X-Force, Fearless Defenders and the X-Men.

name: Moonstone
deck: Dr. Karla Sofen is a founding member of the Thunderbolts and a former member of the Masters of Evil. She has flirted with both sides of the law in Norman Osborn's Avengers as Ms. Marvel. She's a control freak with nearly limitless power granted her by moonstones, hence her codename.

name: Morag
deck: He is a member of the Kree. He is a prehistoric leader.

name: Mordecai Boggs
deck: Former manager of Rick Jones.

name: Mordecai Midas
deck: A wealthy businessman and enemy of Iron Man

name: Mordred
deck: The Witch, member of the Myrrdin's Twilight Court

name: Mordred the Evil
deck: The bastard son of King Arthur and his half-sister Morgause.

name: Morgan Le Fay
deck: Morgan Le Fay is among the most powerful sorceresses in the history of the Earth. She is a frequent adversary of Spider-Woman, The Avengers and Captain Britain, and the sometimes lover of Doctor Doom.

name: Moses
deck: A powerful prophet.

name: Moses Magnum
deck: Moses became President of Deterrence Research Corporation, which is the world's independent weapons manufacturing firm. This would lead to several conflicts with heroes. Moses Magnum is an arms dealer, terrorist, and a supervillain

name: Mother Night
deck: The former nanny of the Red Skull's daughter, Sin.

name: Motormouth
deck: A British superhero with an attitude.

name: Mourning Prey
deck: Butterfly-like woman created by Martian geneticists

name: Mr. Doll
deck: A mind controlling villain, who hasn`t appeared all that much.

name: Mr. Fantastic
deck: Reed Richards, also known as Mr. Fantastic, is the leader of the Fantastic Four. He can stretch his body to great distances due to his exposure to cosmic rays while in space. He is also considered to be one of the smartest men alive, using his brain to explore alternate dimensions and save the world alongside his family from science-based threats.

name: Mr. Horse
deck: A humble horse from Vanaheim who is rescued by Jane Foster. Mr. Horse shows his appreciation by accompanying Jane, and later Runa, as a companion of the Valkyrior.

name: Mr. Hyde
deck: Inspired by the famous novel, Zabo concocted a similar formula. Repeated use of this formula destroyed his sanity and turned him into a savage schizophrenic creature.

name: Mr. Immortal
deck: The first and only known member of a species called Homo Supreme, Craig Hollis is the immortal founder of the eccentric superhero team known as the Great Lakes Avengers and was the team leader until the team moved to Detroit.

name: Mr. Sinister
deck: Mr. Sinister is a supervillain originating from Marvel Comics. Nathaniel Essex was a 19th Century scientist that was genetically mutated by Apocalypse, who shared his philosophy of Social Darwinism. Becoming the immortal Mr. Sinister, he is perhaps the greatest geneticist in the world; capable of cloning, creating, enhancing, and controlling mutant abilities. Sinister is one of the X-Men's most dangerous enemies.

name: Ms America
deck: A superheroine who was a member of the short-lived New Teen Brigade, the Young Avengers, and the Ultimates. Recently, she became the latter team's leader.

name: Munin
deck: Munin (Memory) is one of Odin's Ravens.

name: Mur-G'nn
deck: Mur'Gnn is the sorceress of the Knights of the Infinite.

name: Mustang
deck: Mustang is the son of She-Hulk and Hawkeye on Earth-9811.

name: Mutaurus
deck: Asgard monster

name: Mysterio
deck: Mysterio was a formidable foe to Spider-Man. So much so that his arts of illusion were carried on by others after the original Mysterio's death. The original Mysterio, Quentin Beck, has recently returned. The events behind his resurrection are currently shrouded in mystery.

name: Mystique
deck: True to her name, the shape shifting Mystique is an enigma. Is she a mutant terrorist determined to bring about the end of humanity, or a misguided mutant with a good heart?

name: N'kalla
deck: N'kalla was a child gladiator made to represent the Skrulls in a mock Kree-Skrull War that was saved by the Fantastic Four and eventually adopted by Ben and Alicia Grimm

name: Nadia van Dyne
deck: Daughter of Hank Pym and his first wife, Maria Trovaya. After escaping from the Red Room, she decided to use the alias of the Wasp.

name: Naja
deck: Naja is a Nuhuman who befriended Inferno and Flint.

name: Namor
deck: Namor the Sub-Mariner is the ruler of undersea Atlantis. The offspring of a sea captain and an Atlantean princess, he has been both a hero and a villain to the surface world. Namor is one of Marvel's oldest published characters with his origins in the Golden Age of comics.

name: Namora
deck: Daughter of an Atlantean man and surface woman. The Golden Age hero Namora is cousin to Namor and, like him, is one of Marvel's first mutants. She is currently working under Jimmy Woo with the Agents of Atlas.

name: Namorita
deck: Namorita is the cousin of savage Namor the Sub-Mariner. She was a prominent member of the New Warriors since their inception. However, some may say she was the cause for her and her teammates to die in the catalyst explosion of the Civil War. She recently returned displaced from time.

name: Nathaniel Richards
deck: Time travelling father of Mister Fantastic, he often has mysterious plans and ulterior motives.

name: Nelson Rockefeller
deck: Four term Governor of New York State and 41st Vice-President of the United States

name: Neodymium
deck: The Elements of Doom are recreated by AIM. Neodymium is another dangerous member.

name: Nerkkod
deck: The Breaker of Oceans was one of the seven spirits that served Kul. Member of The Worthy.

name: Network
deck: Valerie Martin is a genius level scientist, doctor and computer hacker that created an exo-suit which lets her collect electronically transmitted data & store it in her head piece (which limits are currently unknown).

name: Neutron
deck: Neutron is a veteran member of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard. He was recently killed during the events of Realm of Kings.

name: Nezarr the Calculator
deck: Nezarr the Calculator is a member of the Celestials, a race of cosmic beings who have conducted genetic experiments on countless worlds throughout the universe. Nezarr's sole duty is to examine and catalogue all data brought to him by the others, and produce the findings to Arishem the Judge.

name: Nick Fury
deck: Nicholas Joseph Fury served in World War II as the leader of the Howling Commandos. He later became an agent, and eventually director, of S.H.I.E.L.D. Fury is one of the greatest strategic minds in the world, a born leader and a master of espionage. He currently serves as a replacement Watcher.

name: Nick Fury Jr.
deck: Once known as Marcus Johnson, Nick Fury Jr. is the second son of the legendary Nick Fury. With a military history and a knack for espionage, he has gone on to follow his father's footsteps as an agent of S.H.I.E.L.D., an Avenger, and a one-man anti-terrorist unit.

name: Nico Minoru
deck: The daughter of Robert & Tina Minoru who is the unofficial leader of the Runaways. She possesses the Staff of One, a mystical staff which can grand any wish, but only once.

name: Nidhogg
deck: Called the "Eater of the Dead", Nidhogg lives among the roots of Yggdrasil. A creature of great power, Nidhogg feeds on the the corpses upon the shores of Nastrond - the unworthy dead who comitted murder and broke oaths.

name: Night Thrasher
deck: Dwayne Taylor was the leader of the superhero-group known as the New Warriors. He was presumed dead in the explosion in Stamford, CT but was actually whisked away to a mutiversal Contest of Champions and later returned to his home universe.

name: Nightcrawler
deck: Kurt Wagner is a prominent member of the X-Men and former member and leader of Excalibur. He possessed the Neyaphemian ability of teleportation, as well as incredible agility, wall scaling and a prehensile tail. Nightcrawler is a devout Catholic, contrasting his demonic appearance. He is a highly skilled swordsmen and former circus acrobat.

name: Nightfall
deck: Nightfall is one of the new Inhumans that emerged after the global terrigenesis and is a member of Lash's tribe.

name: Nighthawk
deck: Kyle Richmond was a thrill-seeking playboy who became the costumed adventurer Nighthawk. Starting out as a villain, Richmond soon found altruism a greater pursuit. As Nighthawk, he became mainstay of the Defenders, and has also acted alongside the Squadron Supreme, the Redeemers, the Thunderbolts and the Initiative.

name: Nightmask
deck: An artificial human created by Ex Nihilo who was endowed with cosmic powers by the White Event.

name: Nikki
deck: Nikki was born on Mercury and joined the Guardians of the Galaxy after her planet was attacked by the Badoon.

name: Nimrod
deck: A nigh-invincible Sentinel from Earth-811, the Days of Future Past timeline.

name: Nitro
deck: Nitro is a supervillain in the Marvel Comics universe. He is known best for being responsible for the death of Captain Marvel and later the mass killing in Stamford triggering the superhuman Civil War.

name: No-Name
deck: No-Name is a nameless broodspawn that was stranded on Sakaar after a failed Brood attack. She later became part of Hulk's Warbound.

name: Noh-Varr
deck: Noh-Varr was the youngest member of a Kree diplomatic team that was blown out of the sky after reaching Earth. Noh-Varr was the only one who survived. He then vowed vengeance on all mankind but was later tasked with protecting them in the name of the Kree, becoming Captain Marvel and later the Protector. After being forced out of the Avengers, he would then become a part of the Young Avengers.

name: Nomad
